description: Input schema for Seedream 4.5 image generation.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate. Be descriptive about style, composition, and details.
examples: A majestic mountain landscape at sunset with golden light reflecting off snow-capped peaks

image.description: Optional reference image for image-to-image generation. If not provided, generates from text only.
image.title: Image

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the generated image.
watermark.title: Watermark
